title: Answer your own questions with data (SQL basics)
summary: Being able to run a simple query means you can check a hunch in minutes instead of waiting for an analyst. You don't need to be an expert.

beginner: Learn what a table, a row and a column are.
Practise SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY and LIMIT in a free interactive course.
Learn COUNT, SUM, AVG and GROUP BY.
Ask an analyst for read-only access to a safe copy of your product's data.
Answer one real question each week, and check the result with an analyst.
intermediate: Join tables to answer questions across users and events.
Build simple funnels and cohorts yourself.
Save useful queries so others can reuse them.
experienced: Review your team's key queries for mistakes in definitions.
Agree shared definitions, such as active user, with data teams.
Coach PMs to answer their own questions safely.

canDelegateTo.task: Give access and check early results

toolExamples.looker: Explore saved views before writing your own queries.
toolExamples.power-bi: Check your query results against an existing report.
toolExamples.claude: Ask an AI assistant to explain a query, then check it yourself.

definitionOfDone: Three real questions answered and checked
pitfalls: Trusting a result without checking definitions
